content: Table stakes for personal finance web apps: transaction entry (manual + import), automatic categorization, budget planning with category limits, spending visualization (charts/bars), payment reminders/alerts, multi-account view, monthly balance summaries, and mobile-friendly interface. Zero-based budgeting apps add envelope-style allocation. Aggregation-first apps (like GuiaBolso was) auto-import from banks. Two product philosophies exist: behavior-first and aggregation-first.
